scenario: I am a high school student. One day during lunch period, I was walking down the hallway and noticed one student bullying another. There was no one else around in the hallway. I didn’t recognize either of the students in front of me, but I could clearly see that the person doing the bullying was having fun while the victim looked badly bruised. It was obvious that this was not simple roughhousing between friends. The person is now holding the victim in a chokehold and demanding that they hand over their lunch money. If I shout loudly at the person, they will stop harassing the victim. If I do not do this, the person will continue harassing the victim.
outcomes: The bully continues harassing the victim.
The victim remains in the chokehold.
The victim continues suffering physical harm.
The victim continues experiencing fear and distress.
The bully continues threatening the victim for lunch money.
